text:
linus: Quick sync — bringing up q7-mini (14b -> q7) in staging with speculative decode ON. Baseline hosted EM on codegen-suite was 0.72; with q7+spec it fell to 0.64. Anyone seen this pattern? Wondering if KV cache aliasing or sampler/tuning interactions. /cc @maria

maria: Do we have the exact config? batch, sampler, kernel overrides?

linus: Pasted config: ```model: q7-mini-14b
quant: q7
speculative: enabled
speculative_cutoff: 0.7
sampler: top_k=50 temp=0.2 seed=42
batch: 8
force_kernel: none``` We used the new hash-quant kernel from mmengine-2.1.0 in staging.

ajay: Curious — does quant fallback to an fp16/fp32 path for some seq lengths? q7 sometimes hits a different kernel which changes normalization. Can you run with --force-kernel=quant_kv and compare?

linus: Started two jobs: job/7965432111 (force-kernel=quant_kv) and job/7965432133 (speculative disabled). CI will post results.

ci-bot: job/7965432111 finished: latency p95 = 92ms (baseline 88ms), EM = 0.70, perplexity +2.1%. job/7965432133 finished: latency p95 = 110ms, EM = 0.71, perplexity +1.6%.

noor: Interesting — force-kernel recovers some quality but not fully. My hypothesis: speculative prefill is mis-speculating on a small fraction of tokens and that shifts beam scoring downstream (token bias). Can we dump token-level logits for mismatch cases (small sample first)? I can triage quickly if we have dumps.

linus: Uploaded a tiny diff sample inline: token 23 expected ";" got "," (logit delta ~ -1.8). Full dump going to GCS: gs://redwood-staging/q7-spec/dumps/7965432100.tar.gz. Will add mapping from request-id -> example.

maria: Proposal: keep q7 quant but disable speculative decode for codegen endpoints as a quick mitigation. Canary to 5% and run the eval harness (the same codegen-unit suite) against production traffic. Also add a regression alert: EM drop > 5% triggers rollback.

ajay: +1. Also add prompt-normalization check — some codegen tasks are very sensitive to trailing newline/whitespace; speculative prefill sometimes trims/normalizes prefixes. Try forced-prefix-preserve flag and re-run small holdout.

linus: Ok i'll set the canary and the alert. Kicking off canary rollout now and running prompt-preserve job. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy canary initiated: rollout/7965432144 -> 5%

maria: After canary results, if EM still down we should run 1) token-level diff audit for top-100 regressions, 2) quant kernel microbench (check mean logit scale), 3) run with speculative but stricter cutoff (0.85) to see threshold sensitivity.

linus: noted. I'll create a short checklist in the ticket and link results to the rollout.
